//: Credentials that must exist on the n8n instance before deploy. NEVER commit real values.
//how: Workflow JSON references __CRED__:<alias>; deploy.ts resolves alias -> name -> real id via GET /api/v1/credentials (doc 09 §6.2).
//why-only-one: n8n holds NO third-party credentials. Every outbound notification goes through Core API's /internal/notify/* so that 10DLC, opt-out and consent enforcement live in one place and cannot be bypassed (doc 09 §3.4). Adding a Slack or Twilio node here would reintroduce that bypass.

required.setup: Header Auth credential. Name: Authorization. Value: Bearer $GRACE_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN

deferred.status: NOT IN SCOPE — Slack is not currently on the platform list.
deferred.note: If Slack is adopted later it becomes a Core API notification channel behind /internal/notify/*, not an n8n node. No workflow change required.
